description.zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
description.en: The maximum number of records to return in this request.
Filters messages with a time earlier than the specified value.
Filters messages with a time later than the specified value.

description.zh: 分页游标，如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。说明 该参数只要返回数据，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到返回为Null，表示获取到了所有的数据。
description.en: The pagination token. If there is a next page, this field has a return value. This parameter indicates that there is a next page as long as data is returned. You can use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to obtain the next page of data until Null is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bdrc list-messages --next-token cae0000000000099 --max-results 100 --message-time-later-than 1740019609 --message-time-earlier-than 1740019610 --message-type SUB_PROTECTION_POLICY_MODIFIED --message-level WARNING --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bdrc GET /api/v1/messages --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken cae0000000000099 --MessageTimeLaterThan 1740019609 --MaxResults 100 --MessageTimeEarlierThan 1740019610 --MessageLevel WARNING --MessageType SUB_PROTECTION_POLICY_MODIFIED --header "Content-Type=application/json"
